description: This source file implements functions related to logcat output handling in the Cuttlefish project, including generating logcat info and setting up a logcat receiver command with a named pipe.

methods.name: LogcatInfo
methods.description: Returns a string with logcat output information including the logcat path from the given instance.

methods.name: LogcatReceiver
methods.description: Creates and returns a Result containing a command to start logcat receiver, setting up a named pipe for log output.
